policies.topic: Hall Ticket Generation and Download Deadlines
policies.summary: Hall tickets are released online 7 days before semester exams commence and can be downloaded from the student portal after clearing fee dues.
policies.details: To download the hall ticket, students must have nil fee dues, minimum required attendance (75% or approved condonation), and completed course feedback. If the hall ticket download button is disabled, check with Finance or Academic Affairs.
policies.actionable: Verify no pending fee dues and 75% attendance. If blocked unfairly, create an urgent ticket to Examination Cell.

policies.summary: Supplementary examinations are conducted within 30 days after the publication of regular semester results.
policies.details: Students with 'F' or 'RA' grades can register for supplementary exams through the exam portal by paying the re-exam fee of ₹500 per subject within 10 days of notification. Maximum of 4 attempts permitted per subject.
policies.actionable: Register on the portal within the 10-day window or contact Examination Cell for manual registration.

policies.summary: Students may apply for answer script copy and revaluation within 15 days of result declaration.
policies.details: Fee for answer script photocopy is ₹300 per subject. Fee for revaluation is ₹750 per subject. If the mark changes by more than 15%, the fee is 50% refunded. Grade upgrades or downgrades are final.
policies.actionable: Apply via Exam Portal or submit revaluation request form to Controller of Examinations.
